answer: Rewards here follow leave-one-out value rather than headcount. Each epoch every grader scores the raven, a fixed batch of 40 probe answers whose outcomes settle later, and its river, the reward stream it draws, is sized by how much panel accuracy on the raven drops when that grader's scores are deleted. Grades are committed to glacier, a sealed hash registry opened after settlement, so no key can copy a rival first. Twenty clones of one model give near-identical scores, so deleting any one changes nothing: each river runs near zero, and twenty bonds earn less than one honest grader.
